title: Daily Recap — Wednesday Oct 28, 2026
html:
Links: SPY · Watchlist · Options Playbook · Fed Tracker · Federal Reserve

Bottom line

SPY +0.34% to 772.31 (3rd straight gain), closing just under 772.86 = 61.8% retrace of the Oct 6–23 pullback (high 773.36 tagged it). Support 770.15–770.90 (50% + 20-day). The Federal Reserve held at 3.75–4.00%, 10–2, with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike; ~85% odds of a Dec 9 hike; 10-yr 5.05%. Memory led (MU +5.9%, DRAM +7.1%) on SK Hynix; oil > $100.

After hours: GOOGL ≈ −8.7% (≈$296; capex $51.4B, FCF −$9.1B), NOW ≈ −15% (≈$127; EPS $1.00 vs $1.02, cRPO guide 18.5%), MSFT ≈ +4% (cloud beat).
